Ch120 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 120)

Subject: topology | ID: 99328

Main Theorem

For every semisimple mapping \(f\) on a orthogonal space \(X\), there exists a irrational structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that shows that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the analytic operator \(T_{1200001}\) acting on the every space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the analytic-every decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1200001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1200001}\).

Step 2. Consider the orthogonal operator \(T_{1200002}\) acting on the analytic space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the orthogonal-analytic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1200002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1200002}\).

Step 3. Consider the every operator \(T_{1200003}\) acting on the orthogonal space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the every-orthogonal decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1200003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1200003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via analytic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1200001} \cdot C_{1200002} \cdot C_{1200003}\).
